claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tolazamide is a first-generation sulfonylurea that binds the beta-cell sulfonylurea receptor (ABCC8/Kir6.2) with low micromolar affinity, but at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity in a pooled cancer cell-line viability screen, since its pharmacology is cytostatic/metabolic rather than directly lethal.
